dominant_strengths: Warm amber-on-near-black palette feels editorial and premium, with restrained accent use that elevates the data hierarchy
Serif italic 'momentum' paired with clean sans creates a confident, magazine-grade headline moment
Tooltip detail, sparklines, and dotted prior-year line show genuine craft attention beyond a generic dashboard
dominant_weaknesses: KPI row feels cramped: sparklines sit awkwardly close to deltas with no clear column rhythm or alignment grid
Chart x-axis labels and legend are weakly weighted; 'Current/Prior year' chips fight the headline value tooltip for attention
Layout is conventional SaaS metrics card—innovation is in skin, not in structure or interaction model
fix_priorities: Reflow KPI cards onto a stricter grid with consistent label/value/delta/spark spacing
Strengthen chart axis typography and add subtle gridline hierarchy so the curve reads against time
Push a distinguishing interaction (scrubbing, comparison toggle) to lift innovation past stylistic reskin
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral warmth and reflective tone, but behavioral clarity lags due to soft axis labels and tight KPI packing.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it reads clearly as a refined dashboard card with credible metrics, chart, and metadata, just not a category-redefining one.
